overviews.name: CARDDEMO
key_points: Online, signs users on and lets them view and update accounts and cards, list, view and add transactions, pay a bill and request reports; admin users maintain the user security file.
In batch, posts the daily transaction file, calculates interest and fees, combines and backs up transactions, and produces account statements and the transaction report over VSAM files.

overviews.name: CARDDEMO
key_points: Runs the CardDemo batch cycle defined in the CA 7 listing: closes the CICS files, posts the daily transaction file to the transaction master and category balances, and reopens the files.

Also reloads the transaction type, transaction category and category balance reference files, prints the account, card, customer and cross-reference files, and produces account statements with a PDF conversion step.
One scheduled job, CBPAUP0J, has no JCL member in this module's scan, so its part in the cycle is not proven here.

overviews.name: DAILY-TransactionBackup
key_points: Backs up the processed transaction file to a new backup generation and rebuilds the transaction VSAM file, with the CICS files closed beforehand and reopened afterwards.
The scheduler definitions describe its four jobs as DAILY.

overviews.name: WEEKLY-TransactionTypesDBRefresh
key_points: Schedules one job, MNTTRDB2, described as WEEKLY; no JCL member for it is in this module's scan, so what it processes is not proven here.

overviews.name: DisclosureGroupsRefresh
key_points: Reloads the disclosure group file from its flat-file source, with the CICS files closed beforehand and reopened afterwards.
The scheduler definitions describe its jobs as WEEKLY DisclosureGroupsRefresh.

overviews.name: TransactionTypesDBRefresh
key_points: Schedules one job, TRANEXTR, described as WEEKLY TransactionTypesDBRefresh; no JCL member for it is in this module's scan, so what it processes is not proven here.

overviews.name: MONTHLY-InterestCalculation
key_points: Only INTCALC.STEP15 is in-scope stream logic; the four other folder jobs are scheduler neighbours.
COMBTRAN consumes SYSTRAN outside the stream; fixed cycle PARM, recovery and SDSF quiescence remain unproven.

descriptions.name: CBACT01C
descriptions.description: Batch: reads the account master file and writes its records to three output files, calling the assembler routine COBDATFT to format a date.

descriptions.name: CBACT02C
descriptions.description: Batch: reads the card data file and prints its records.

descriptions.name: CBACT03C
descriptions.description: Batch: reads the account cross-reference file and prints its records.

descriptions.name: CBACT04C
descriptions.description: Batch interest calculator: processes the transaction category balance file and computes interest and fees.
key_points: Truncates interest and updates accounts on account transitions; the final account is not updated at EOF.

descriptions.name: CBCUS01C
descriptions.description: Batch: reads the customer data file and prints its records.

descriptions.name: CBEXPORT
descriptions.description: Batch: exports customer data for branch migration into a single export file.

descriptions.name: CBFEEDRV
descriptions.description: Batch driver: reads the account master and calls the late-fee routine CBFEECAL for each account.

descriptions.name: CBIMPORT
descriptions.description: Batch: imports customer data from the branch-migration export file into separate import files, with an error file.

descriptions.name: CBSTM03A
descriptions.description: Batch: prints account statements from transaction data.

descriptions.name: CBSTM03B
descriptions.description: Batch subroutine: does the file processing for the statement/transaction report program.

descriptions.name: CBTRN01C
descriptions.description: Batch: posts the records from the daily transaction file.

descriptions.name: CBTRN02C
descriptions.description: Batch: posts the records from the daily transaction file.

descriptions.name: CBTRN03C
descriptions.description: Batch: prints the transaction detail report.

descriptions.name: COACTUPC
descriptions.description: CICS: accepts and processes an account update.

descriptions.name: COACTVWC
descriptions.description: CICS: accepts and processes an account view request.

descriptions.name: COADM01C
descriptions.description: CICS: admin menu for admin users; transfers control to the program of the option chosen.

descriptions.name: COBIL00C
descriptions.description: CICS: bill payment - pays an account balance in full.

descriptions.name: COBSWAIT
descriptions.description: Reads a centisecond delay from SYSIN and calls MVSWAIT.

descriptions.name: COCRDLIC
descriptions.description: CICS: lists credit cards.

descriptions.name: COCRDSLC
descriptions.description: CICS: accepts and processes a credit card detail request.

descriptions.name: COCRDUPC
descriptions.description: CICS: accepts and processes a credit card detail request (program header; the menu table names it Credit Card Update).

descriptions.name: COMEN01C
descriptions.description: CICS: main menu for regular users; transfers control to the program of the option chosen.

descriptions.name: CORPT00C
descriptions.description: CICS: prints transaction reports by submitting a batch job.

descriptions.name: COSGN00C
descriptions.description: CICS: signon screen of the CardDemo application.

descriptions.name: COTRN00C
descriptions.description: CICS: lists transactions from the TRANSACT file.

descriptions.name: COTRN01C
descriptions.description: CICS: views one transaction from the TRANSACT file.

descriptions.name: COTRN02C
descriptions.description: CICS: adds a new transaction to the TRANSACT file.

descriptions.name: COUSR00C
descriptions.description: CICS: lists all users from the USRSEC file.

descriptions.name: COUSR01C
descriptions.description: CICS: adds a new regular or admin user to the USRSEC file.

descriptions.name: COUSR02C
descriptions.description: CICS: updates a user in the USRSEC file.

descriptions.name: COUSR03C
descriptions.description: CICS: deletes a user from the USRSEC file.

descriptions.name: CSUTLDTC
descriptions.description: Utility subprogram: validates a date by calling the Language Environment service CEEDAYS.

descriptions.name: ACCTFILE
descriptions.description: Deletes and redefines the account VSAM KSDS and loads it from the ACCTDATA.PS flat file.

descriptions.name: CARDFILE
descriptions.description: Closes the CICS files, rebuilds the card VSAM KSDS from CARDDATA.PS with its alternate index and path, then reopens the files.

descriptions.name: CBADMCDJ
descriptions.description: Runs DFHCSDUP to create the CICS resources of the CardDemo application.

descriptions.name: CBEXPORT
descriptions.description: Defines the EXPORT.DATA cluster and runs CBEXPORT over the customer, account, cross-reference, transaction and card files.

descriptions.name: CBIMPORT
descriptions.description: Runs CBIMPORT to split EXPORT.DATA into customer, account, cross-reference and transaction import files plus an error file.

descriptions.name: CLOSEFIL
descriptions.description: Submits file control commands through SDSF; runtime quiescence is not proven.

descriptions.name: COMBTRAN
descriptions.description: Sorts the current transaction file together with the system-generated transactions and loads the combined file to the transaction master.

descriptions.name: CREASTMT
descriptions.description: Creates a statement for each card in the cross-reference file: sorts transactions, rebuilds a work cluster and runs CBSTM03A.

descriptions.name: CUSTFILE
descriptions.description: Closes the CICS files, rebuilds the customer VSAM KSDS from CUSTDATA.PS, then reopens the files.

descriptions.name: DALYREJS
descriptions.description: Defines the generation data group for daily rejects (DALYREJS).

descriptions.name: DEFCUST
descriptions.description: Deletes and defines the customer cluster AWS.CUSTDATA.CLUSTER.

descriptions.name: DEFGDGB
descriptions.description: Defines the generation data groups for transaction backup, daily transactions, transaction report, category-balance backup, system transactions and combined transactions.

descriptions.name: DEFGDGD
descriptions.description: Creates generation data groups for transaction reference data and loads their first generation.

descriptions.name: DISCGRP
descriptions.description: Deletes and redefines the disclosure group VSAM KSDS and loads it from DISCGRP.PS.

descriptions.name: DUSRSECJ
descriptions.description: Builds the user security file: writes USRSEC.PS from in-stream data, defines the USRSEC VSAM KSDS and loads it.

descriptions.name: ESDSRRDS
descriptions.description: Writes a flat file from in-stream data and defines and loads USRSEC ESDS and RRDS clusters from it.

descriptions.name: FEECALC
descriptions.description: Month-end late-fee calculation: runs the COBOL driver CBFEEDRV, which calls the routine CBFEECAL.

descriptions.name: FTPJCLS
descriptions.description: Runs an FTP step that PUTs the dataset AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST to a remote folder as welcome.txt.

descriptions.name: INTCALC
descriptions.description: Processes the transaction category balance file and computes interest and fees by running CBACT04C.

descriptions.name: INTRDRJ1
descriptions.description: Copies the FTP test dataset to a backup with IDCAMS REPRO, then submits member INTRDRJ2 through IEBGENER.

descriptions.name: INTRDRJ2
descriptions.description: Copies the FTP test backup dataset to an INTRDR-suffixed copy with IDCAMS REPRO.

descriptions.name: OPENFIL
descriptions.description: Submits file control commands through SDSF; runtime quiescence is not proven.

descriptions.name: POSTTRAN
descriptions.description: Processes and loads the daily transaction file by running CBTRN02C, creating transaction category balances and updating the transaction master.

descriptions.name: PRTCATBL
descriptions.description: Unloads the transaction category balance file through PROC REPROC, then sorts it by account, type and category and formats the balance for printing.

descriptions.name: READACCT
descriptions.description: Runs CBACT01C over the account VSAM file, after deleting its three previous output files.

descriptions.name: READCARD
descriptions.description: Runs CBACT02C to read and print the card file.

descriptions.name: READCUST
descriptions.description: Runs CBCUS01C to read and print the customer file.

descriptions.name: READXREF
descriptions.description: Runs CBACT03C to read and print the account cross-reference file.

descriptions.name: REPTFILE
descriptions.description: Defines the generation data group for the transaction report (TRANREPT).

descriptions.name: TCATBALF
descriptions.description: Deletes and redefines the transaction category balance VSAM KSDS and loads it from TCATBALF.PS.

descriptions.name: TRANBKP
descriptions.description: Repros the processed transaction file to a backup through PROC REPROC, then deletes and redefines the transaction VSAM file.

descriptions.name: TRANCATG
descriptions.description: Deletes and redefines the transaction category VSAM KSDS and loads it from TRANCATG.PS.

descriptions.name: TRANFILE
descriptions.description: Closes the CICS files, rebuilds the transaction VSAM KSDS from DALYTRAN.PS.INIT with its alternate index and path, then reopens the files.

descriptions.name: TRANIDX
descriptions.description: Defines the alternate index and path on the transaction VSAM file and builds the index.

descriptions.name: TRANREPT
descriptions.description: Unloads the processed transaction file, filters it for the parameter dates and sorts it by card number, then runs CBTRN03C to print the report.

descriptions.name: TRANTYPE
descriptions.description: Deletes and redefines the transaction type VSAM KSDS and loads it from TRANTYPE.PS.

descriptions.name: TXT2PDF1
descriptions.description: Runs TXT2PDF under IKJEFT1B over the statement file STATEMNT.PS.

descriptions.name: WAITSTEP
descriptions.description: Runs the wait utility COBSWAIT.

descriptions.name: XREFFILE
descriptions.description: Deletes and redefines the card cross-reference VSAM KSDS, loads it from CARDXREF.PS and builds its alternate index and path.

descriptions.name: REPROC
descriptions.description: PROC: one IDCAMS step used by the jobs to REPRO one dataset to another.

descriptions.name: TRANREPT
descriptions.description: PROC form of the transaction report: unload the transaction file, filter and sort it, run CBTRN03C.
